label: Senior React / Front-End Developer
summary: Senior React and Front-End Developer with 8+ years of experience creating responsive, data-driven interfaces for healthcare, SaaS, and e-commerce products. Deep experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, GraphQL, Material UI, Shopify Polaris, and modern build tooling. Combines component architecture and API integration skills with full-stack awareness to deliver maintainable interfaces and faster development workflows.

bullets.text: Led delivery of healthcare web applications and integration demos, translating FHIR and consent workflows into usable practitioner and patient experiences.
Built a SMART on FHIR application with Medplum and OAuth2 to demonstrate consent-aware EHR-to-EHR data exchange.
Developed a Next.js and React dashboard for displaying and managing FHIR consent forms and questionnaire responses.
Built an LHC-Forms interface for digital consent capture and contributed reusable FHIR profiles and value sets.
Built Shopify embedded applications with React, Polaris, App Bridge, and GraphQL for wishlist and bundle-pricing merchant workflows.
Established reusable modules in a monorepo and collaborated across frontend and backend boundaries to ship production features.
Built patient and administrator portals with React, Redux, Material UI, GraphQL, and Next.js for a production consent platform.
Migrated proprietary state logic to Redux and replaced Webpack with Vite, reducing CI build time by 75%.
Created real-time product filtering, comparison, and search experiences using Web Components, GraphQL, and Shopify APIs.
Built a Next.js and Polaris administration interface for product specifications, metafields, and bulk CSV imports.
Developed Shopify theme and app customizations and authored a reusable JavaScript integration library, reducing support resolution time by 30%.
